one_line: A bright, chilly winter wonderland where you can walk right out onto the frozen lake and fish through a little hole in the ice.
strengths: The bite shot frames the red and white bobber inside a dark blue ice hole, giving it great contrast when a fish strikes.
Dark brown wooden shacks, logs, and fences stand out cleanly against the white snow and pale blue ice.
Walking onto a frozen version of a familiar lake has huge novelty and adventure appeal for 8 to 13 year old players.
Crisp blue skies and cool blue shadows keep the winter mood bright, calm, and inviting rather than bleak.
risks: The white fishing line in the bite shot and the snow-covered dock planks in the lake shot blend into the bright snow and ice on a small phone screen.
Turning the lake into solid ice breaks regular open-water casting, so the team cannot easily ship this look before building the ice-fishing mode.
Roblox Terrain voxels are too chunky to carve small, neat fishing holes cleanly, so holes will need custom mesh parts or faked dark circles.
On mobile graphics settings, Roblox ice looks much flatter than these frosted, glossy surfaces, risking a plain flat blue sheet.
made_up: Wooden ice-fishing shacks added to the lake and shore in every image.
A winter parka and fur hat outfit, a sitting crate, and propped-up spare fishing rods standing on the ice.
Smoothly blended snowdrifts, scratched translucent ice shaders, chipped ice chunks, and sharp-edged holes cut cleanly down into liquid water.
Stamped footprints along the snowy path in the creek shot and frosted reeds sticking through the frozen lake.
Realistic bare deciduous trees with fine twigs mixed in with the game's chunky geometric pine trees.
A red and white buoy frozen into the middle of the ice in the bite shot.
